data.name: Bulhut
data.long_meaning: The name Bulhut is derived from the Arabic word ‘bulhulah’, which means ‘a fragrant flower’. This name is mentioned in a Hadith narrated by Anas ibn Malik, who reported that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: ‘The name of the best of you is the one who has the best name.’ This name is considered to have a spiritual and beautiful meaning, and is a reminder of the importance of good character and a pleasant disposition.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the beauty and fragrance of good character.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Bulhut suggests creativity, self-expression, and a loving nature. People with this name are often seen as gentle, compassionate, and artistic, and are drawn to beauty and aesthetics. They may have a strong sense of intuition and a deep connection to the spiritual world.

in_english.name: Bulhut
in_english.meaning: Diver in the depths of knowledge
in_english.long_meaning: The name Bulhut is derived from the Arabic root 'bḥ-w-t', which means to dive or plunge into something. It signifies one who delves deeply into knowledge and wisdom. Historically, this name has been used in Islamic tradition to denote individuals who are profoundly engaged in scholarly pursuits and spiritual exploration. The name embodies the qualities of intellectual curiosity and spiritual depth.
